task: Rebuild racing Roadster using accurate visual references before screen recording
credit: Tesla press photography reproduced by Car and Driver; source ramp movie and user stills are primary action/variant references
source_identity: White/silver wedge Roadster in supplied ramp footage, not the rounded 2017 prototype

candidates.a-fender-shells: Separate wheel-fender pods and door/hood panels; less continuous transitions
candidates.b-extruded-profiles: Extruded side outlines with actual wheel cutouts; side reflection and silhouette too slab-like
candidates.c-parametric-coachwork: Selected. Continuous crowned bonnet, curved shoulder strips, arch-following side surfaces

revisions: C reduced from 69750 triangles to 50554 before selection
Lowered and extended continuous canopy; changed final height to 1.181m
Stowed headlamp shutters match the ramp variant instead of conspicuous dark deployed pockets
Raised shoulder cross-sections to clear inner tires and wheel-well liners, caught in isolated close-up render
Darkened/recessed lower gimbal housings to separate them from the four upper alloy outlets
Independent four-wheel pivots, low active-wing joint, separate downward outlets retained
Rear boost effect x/y/origin aligned to the new upper outlets; wheel spin radius updated to .42m
measurements_caveat: Dimensions and hidden mechanical construction inferred from photographs, not official CAD or measured manufacturer specifications.

verification.inspection: evidence/racing/roadster-rebuild/; before/after studio frames use identical lights/cameras; gameplay close/pan/rear captures are paused poses, not input proof

scope: Original app/, original car asset, stock assetlib/surfaces, physics, camera timing and soundtrack unchanged. No git commit/push.
